newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 18.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Two Taiwan men arrested in United States on charges of attempted theft of Bistol-Meyer trade secret
--Taiwan governor James Soong sharply criticises Nationalist Party's leading cadres, including Premier Lien Chan, over controversial phase-out of Taiwan provincial government
UNITED DAILY NEWS - National Assembly to start second reading of constititional amendment proposals on Thursday
--Yuen Foong Yu Paper claims trade secret case is a setup
LIBERTY TIMES - Foreign Minister John Chang says in U.S. Taiwan is seeking "parallel existence" of rival sides of Taiwan strait
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Jardine Metheson to invest T$12 billion in Taiwan to diffuse its investment risks in face of Hong Kong handover
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Beijing plans to take back approval right from Hong Kong on Taiwan's banks opening branches in territory
--Share price index compiled by Economic Daily News truly reflects market conditions
